                      PROJECT NARRATIVE AND PLANS

                      TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT

                             1827 South May Street


Rezoning from RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to RM-6
Residential Multi-Unit District

The purpose of rezoning is to allow for the conversion ofthe existing 6 dwelling units to 8 dwelling
units by adding one dwelling unit in the basennent and one dwelling unit in the attic within the
existing residential building. No additional parking spaces will be provided to the existing 3
parking spaces. After rezoning, the building will contain 8 dwelling units and 3 parking spaces.
There will be no comnnercial space. The height and exterior of the existing building will remain
unchanged.

                                                      PROPOSED
                         Lot Area                     2,400 square feet
                         MLA (Lot area per D.U.)      300 per DU
                         Off-street Parking           3 parking spaces

                         South Setback                3 feet (existing)
                         Rear Setback                 39.25 feet (existing)
                         FAR                          2.03 (existing)
                         Building Height              37 feet (Existing)



*2 parking spaces are required. The applicant will obtain a variation to reduce the parking spot
requirements to 0.
